# Leonardo.Ai Documentation

> Documentation for Leonardo.Ai

## Guides: 🏁 Quick start
- [Quick Start Guide](https://docs.leonardo.ai/docs/getting-started.md): Welcome! This guide helps you get started with the Leonardo.Ai API, from creating an API key to generating your first images.

The connector uses the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to enable your AI…

## Guides: Deprecations
- [Deprecations & Changes](https://docs.leonardo.ai/docs/deprecations-changes.md)

## API Reference: Rest Endpoints v2
- [Create Async Generation](https://docs.leonardo.ai/reference/creategeneration.md): Submit a generation job. Returns a generation ID to poll for the finished result.
- [Create Sync Generation](https://docs.leonardo.ai/reference/createsyncgeneration.md): Run a generation and return the finished result in the same response. Only sync-capable models are accepted. The request may take up to ~27 seconds before the service times out.
- [Get Available Models](https://docs.leonardo.ai/reference/getmodels.md): Fetch all production API available models with their parameter specifications.
